corePassives.description: Toshiro charges up when releasing his basic attacks, Ice Dragon Lunge and Daiguren - Flock of Ice Pillars, his Technique, Daiguren - Hyoryu Senbi, and his Counterattack, Ryuusenka. Charging to a certain level generates 1 Ice Blossom, up to a maximum of 8. The number of Ice Blossoms is displayed in cross-shaped ice crystals to the left of HP. When Toshiro releases his Ultimate Hyoten Hyakkaso, all Ice Blossoms are consumed to deal 6% additional DMG for each one consumed.
corePassives.name: Ice Blossom

corePassives.description: When releasing a basic attack while moving in Bankai state, Toshiro gains 1 stack of Build Up, up to 5 stacks. When Toshiro releases his Ultimate Hyoten Hyakkaso, all stacks of Build Up are consumed to deal 5% additional Spirit DMG for each stack consumed. If 5 stacks of Build Up are consumed, Toshiro's Spiritual Pressure is instantly filled to maximum at the end of Bankai state.
corePassives.name: Build Up

corePassives.description: When Toshiro enters Bankai State, each Ice Blossom grants 5% Ultimate Energy. if Toshiro releases Ultimate, Hyoten Hyakkaso, within 20 seconds, raises the Ultimate's damage by 40%.
corePassives.name: All Water is My Weapon

corePassives.description: For each 1% Critical Rate Toshiro has, his basic attack, Ice Dragon Lunge, deals 1.5% more damage, up to 90%.
corePassives.name: The Sky is at My Disposal

rotations.name: Frost Burst
rotations.notes: Toshiro wants frost stacks applied before burst — Technique first, then dump.

skills.description: Toshiro wields Hyorinmaru to strike 5 times, dealing damage equal to 215%~537.5% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure. Ice Dragon Lunge: Toshiro condenses water vapor into an ice dragon which hits 5 times, dealing total DMG equal to 568%~1420% of ATK. Each hit landed charges Ice Blossom by the number of successful hits. Dodging or countering does not reset the attack streak. If the attack is Interrupted, Tenso Jyurin will be prematurely removed.
skills.name: Frost unto the heavens, Hyorinmaru

skills.description: Toshiro instantly creates massive ice crystals and fires them forward, dealing damage equal to 105%~262.5% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure. Enemies hit by the technique are inflicted with 5 Freeze Points. After releasing the technique, creates an area filled with ice pillars ahead. The ice pillars explode in 2.5 seconds, dealing damage equal to 67%~167.5% of ATK to the enemies in the area, inflicting 5 Freeze Points on them, and granting Spiritual Pressure to Toshiro.
skills.name: Ice Wall

skills.description: Toshiro covers his body with ice and enters Bankai state. In this state, Toshiro can fly above the ground and all his moves will be replaced by more powerful ones.
skills.name: Bankai - Daiguren Hyorinmaru

ascend1: Increases the cap of Ice Blossoms to 12, with each Ice Blossom increasing the DMG and Crit DMG of the Ultimate Hyoten Hyakkaso by 2% and 5%. Releasing Hyoten Hyakkaso with 12 Ice Blossoms grants an extra damage bonus by 20% of Ultimate Mastery
Basic attacks deal 20% more DMG to targets affected by Freeze Points, and hitting targets charges Ice Blossom
ascend5: Ice Blossom cap to 12; each +6% DMG and +15% Crit DMG. At 12: extra bonus = 50% of Ultimate Mastery
Basic attacks deal 80% more DMG to frozen targets, and hitting targets charges Ice Blossom

ascend5: During Tenso Jyurin, basic attack damage is increased by 100%, damage taken is reduced by 50% while using basic attacks, and they cannot be interrupted
